_readme: First read of Palo Verde College's program maps (S345, SkyLantern). The census's sequence address for Palo Verde is a '#' link on the homepage (registry, not_read). A web search (2026-10-08) found no map and one lead: the college's Guided Pathways guide (guides.paloverde.edu/pathways/home), which lists twelve transfer degrees and four career tracks under tabs. This read opens its tabs and prints any map, pathway or PDF link.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses, read on one map the index links.
